# xload

> Fast, free and safe downloads for browser userscripts

xload is a catalog of free, open-source browser userscripts. Every script installs in one click with a userscript manager such as Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey, and all code is public on GitHub at https://github.com/u2222223/xload.

Catalog: https://xload.net/

## Userscripts

- [Telegram网页版媒体下载器](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-78d1cd2c/xload-78d1cd2c.html): 一键下载Telegram网页版图片视频语音
- [抖音播放器增强](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/scriptcat-2534-2/scriptcat-2534-2.html): 画质记忆、禁止自动播放、自定义全屏与背景色
- [抖音界面沉浸优化](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/scriptcat-2534-3/scriptcat-2534-3.html): 沉浸模式+手机模式+自定义主题，专注视频内容
- [抖音互动内容屏蔽](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/scriptcat-2534-4/scriptcat-2534-4.html): 弹幕、评论、礼物特效统一屏蔽，关键词与用户黑名单
- [全局字体渲染增强](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/greasyfork-416688-1/greasyfork-416688-1.html): 无需 MacType，享受细腻网页字体阅读体验
- [学术论文免费下载工具](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/scriptcat-1397-1/scriptcat-1397-1.html): 多平台学术论文一键免费下载
- [HTML5视频播放增强](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-d5aaecca/xload-d5aaecca.html): 全能视频播放增强：倍速/截图/画中画/全屏
- [百度网盘视频播放增强](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-578db12d/xload-578db12d.html): 百度网盘视频播放增强，倍速字幕画质全免费
- [通用无限滚动翻页](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-b79c77d9/xload-b79c77d9.html): 自动加载下一页，无缝瀑布流浏览
- [Zhihu Content Filter](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-afe511cf/xload-afe511cf.html): Filter Zhihu cards by type, phrases, users, votes, age, and labeled content.
- [Zhihu Dark Reading Helper](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-8ce5e45a/xload-8ce5e45a.html): Apply a configurable dark reading theme to Zhihu pages and dynamic surfaces.
- [YouTube Ad Controls](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-2c12e291/xload-2c12e291.html): Manage targeted ad handling on YouTube with an immediate off switch.
- [Discord bulk delete messages with preview and stop controls](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-d401bffa/xload-d401bffa.html): Preview and delete messages in Discord channels or DMs with adjustable delays, progress counts, and a stop control.
- [YouTube SponsorBlock Controls](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-d7e6bded/xload-d7e6bded.html): Control SponsorBlock skipping and replay skipped segments on YouTube.
- [通用小说下载器](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/greasyfork-406070-1/greasyfork-406070-1.html): 一键下载全网小说，支持百站解析
- [微软积分商城自动签到](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/scriptcat-1703-1/scriptcat-1703-1.html): 自动完成微软积分每日任务
- [抖音视频流过滤](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/scriptcat-2534-1/scriptcat-2534-1.html): 自定义过滤抖音视频流中的广告、直播和不感兴趣内容
- [X Long Post Expander — Read Available Full Text](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-0157d469/xload-0157d469.html): X long post expander activates supported expansion controls so you can read available long-form text with fewer repeated clicks.
- [Pixiv Artist UID, Profile Media, and Work Type Labels](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-01b8f240/xload-01b8f240.html): Show and copy Pixiv artist IDs, expose valid profile image links, and label loaded works as single, multi-page, or ugoira
- [Product price history tracker & browsing insights for shopping sites](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-1b4011f3/xload-1b4011f3.html): Tracks product prices you view on supported stores and shows the price trend so you can decide when to buy.
- [123pan Download Limit Unlock](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-2fd44db0/xload-2fd44db0.html): Download large files from 123pan drive and share pages without the size limit.
- [YouTube CPU Tamer – Reduce CPU Usage and Battery Drain](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-f023e122/xload-f023e122.html): Reduces YouTube's CPU usage and battery drain on watch, home, embedded, and Music pages by aligning timers with the browser's rendering cycle.
- [GitHub Download Accelerator for Release, Raw and ZIP Files](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-0847f1a6/xload-0847f1a6.html): Adds mirror download links next to GitHub release assets, raw files and ZIP archives so large files download faster without leaving the repository page.
- [GitHub Single File Quick Download from the File List](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-9eb77cc6/xload-9eb77cc6.html): Adds a quick download action to every file row of a GitHub repository list so single files can be saved without opening the raw page.
- [GitHub Git Clone Accelerator and SSH Address Copy](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-c58e4d54/xload-c58e4d54.html): Adds accelerated HTTPS and SSH clone addresses to the GitHub clone panel and copies a complete git clone command in one click.
- [GitHub Folder Download as ZIP for Any Subdirectory](https://xload.net/scripts/userscripts/xload-893d3dc8/xload-893d3dc8.html): Packages the current GitHub subdirectory into a ZIP archive in the browser so a single folder can be downloaded without cloning the whole repository.
